snippet.title: spaces of mine - Trailer
snippet.description:
An explorable introspection on the meaning of spaces/images through a coming-of-age lens. 
Navigate a maze of empty landscapes and bittersweet memories about growing up online.

Play now for free: 
https://big-stretch.itch.io/spaces-of-mine

This was our Postal Games 2025 submission, inspired by a beautiful letter written by Giovanni Rubino.

Gerard San Miguel, Pepe Pintado & Tancla.
